organization.name: Drawscape
organization.offering: Custom artwork based on a client's aircraft, automobile, sailboat, or yacht.
organization.valueProposition: Create personalized artwork that sellers and member organizations can give to clients or members after a sale, at an event, or as a recognition gift.

minimumEvidence: Verify the account through a current official website or another authoritative public source.
Require evidence that the account matches at least one configured account segment.
Prefer accounts with visible client-facing teams that match at least one configured contact persona.
exclude: Service-only or parts-only businesses without a relevant sales motion.
Rental-only businesses unless the user explicitly requests them.
Defunct, acquired, or ambiguous businesses whose current identity cannot be verified.

levels.label: High
levels.description: Strong evidence of fit, a repeatable high-value client relationship, and reachable matching contacts.

levels.label: Medium
levels.description: Qualified account with plausible fit, but weaker volume, contact, or positioning evidence.

levels.label: Low
levels.description: Adjacent account with limited evidence for the configured value proposition.

sourcePreference: Official company websites and company-controlled team or location pages.
Public LinkedIn company pages and public search results.
Reputable industry directories used as discovery leads, followed by primary-source verification.

accountSegments.label: Aircraft Dealers & Brokers
accountSegments.description: Companies that sell or broker business, private, or general-aviation aircraft.

include: Current evidence of aircraft sales, acquisitions, brokerage, or dealership activity.
A visible sales, brokerage, business-development, or client-advisory function.
exclude: Maintenance, avionics, charter, flight training, or management businesses with no aircraft sales evidence.

high: Established aircraft seller or broker with a visible client-facing sales team and current inventory or transaction evidence.
medium: Verified aircraft seller or broker with limited public evidence about volume or team size.
low: Aviation business with aircraft sales as a secondary or weakly supported activity.

sources: Official aircraft inventory and team pages

accountSegments.label: Automotive Dealers
accountSegments.description: Dealerships and dealer groups selling Porsche, luxury, performance, or other high-value automobiles.

include: Current evidence of vehicle sales through a dealership or dealer group.
Prefer Porsche, luxury, performance, collector, and other high-value vehicle sellers.
exclude: Repair, parts, rental, detailing, or service businesses with no vehicle sales operation.

high: Porsche or luxury/performance dealership with a visible sales team and active vehicle inventory.
medium: Premium or mixed-brand dealership with a relevant sales team but less direct fit evidence.
low: General dealership whose inventory and customer experience show limited high-value or gifting relevance.

sources: Official dealership staff and inventory pages

accountSegments.label: Yacht & Sailboat Brokers
accountSegments.description: Brokerages and dealers that sell yachts, sailboats, sailing catamarans, or related high-value vessels.

include: Current evidence of yacht, sailboat, sailing-catamaran, or boat sales and brokerage.
Prefer accounts with visible brokers, sales advisors, or sales leadership.
exclude: Charter-only, marina-only, service-only, or boatyard businesses with no vessel sales evidence.

high: Mainstream or high-volume sailboat dealer or broker with production sailboats, sailing catamarans, active used sailboat inventory, or brands such as Catalina, J/Boats, Beneteau, Jeanneau, Dufour, Hanse, or Lagoon.
medium: Powerboat, motor-yacht, general-boat, mixed-yacht, or otherwise ambiguous broker when neither the high nor low rule is clearly proven.
A company described only generically as a yacht brokerage when current inventory evidence is inconclusive.
low: Primarily luxury-yacht or superyacht broker whose sail evidence is limited to sailing superyachts, custom megayachts, crewed sailing-yacht charters, or occasional large-yacht listings.

sources: Official brokerage inventory and broker pages
Yacht Brokers Association of America CPYB directory: https://members.ybaa.org/cpyb-certified-yacht-brokers/FindStartsWith?term=%23%21
Boat-brand dealer locators and sailing-industry associations

accountSegments.label: Yacht Clubs
accountSegments.description: Private sailing and yachting clubs with member-gift, regatta, event, trophy, or recognition opportunities.

include: A current private sailing or yachting club with active members, sailing programs, regattas, private events, or recognition programs.
Prefer clubs with visible leadership for operations, sailing, racing, events, or member experience.
exclude: Commercial marinas, public boat ramps, and social clubs with no meaningful sailing, yachting, event, or recognition activity.

high: Active regattas, sailing programs, private events, awards, or member-recognition programs plus visible matching leaders.
medium: Verified private yacht or sailing club with plausible gift or event relevance but limited public program detail.
low: Club with weak sailing, event, award, or member-gifting evidence.

sources: Official club leadership, sailing-program, regatta, and private-event pages

contactPersonas.label: Sales Advisors & Representatives
contactPersonas.description: Client-facing individual contributors who guide buyers through a high-value purchase.

contactPersonas.label: Brokers
contactPersonas.description: People directly responsible for aircraft, yacht, or sailboat brokerage and sales relationships.

contactPersonas.label: Sales Leadership
contactPersonas.description: Managers and executives who lead sales teams, territories, or revenue relationships.

contactPersonas.label: Dealership Leadership
contactPersonas.description: Automotive leaders who own or manage the customer experience and gifting decisions.

contactPersonas.label: Business Development
contactPersonas.description: People responsible for partnerships, growth, and client-development programs.

contactPersonas.label: Yacht Club Leadership
contactPersonas.description: Leaders responsible for club operations, marine facilities, and member experience.

contactPersonas.label: Sailing Program Leadership
contactPersonas.description: Leaders and coaches responsible for club sailing, racing, and junior programs.
qualificationNotes: Approve coach titles only when the role belongs to sailing, racing, junior sailing, or a boat-class program.
Do not qualify fitness, racquet, swim, or unrelated athletic coaches unless the user requests them.

contactPersonas.label: Event & Regatta Leadership
contactPersonas.description: People who manage private events, regattas, awards, trophies, or member recognition.
